EnergySense — vendored front-end assets
=======================================

All third-party files in this directory are redistributed unmodified and are
loaded locally at runtime. Nothing here is fetched from a CDN.

Chart.js 4.6.1 — chart.umd.js
  Copyright (c) 2026 Chart.js Contributors
  MIT License — full text in ./chartjs/LICENSE.md
  https://www.chartjs.org

Fraunces (variable, roman + italic) and DM Sans — ./fonts/*.woff2
  Both typefaces are licensed under the SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1.
  Fraunces — Copyright (c) 2018 The Fraunces Project Authors
             https://github.com/undercasetype/Fraunces
  DM Sans  — Copyright (c) 2014 The DM Sans Project Authors
             https://github.com/googlefonts/dm-fonts

  SIL OFL 1.1 permits bundling, embedding and redistribution of the font
  software provided the copyright notice and licence accompany it, and the
  fonts are not sold on their own. Full licence text:
  https://openfontlicense.org/open-font-license-official-text/

These files were copied from the EnergySense landing-page bundle
(static/landing/fonts) so that the landing page and this dashboard render in
exactly the same typefaces without either page depending on the other.
